title: Chapter 609 - 609 Level-Nine Forbidden Area; Desert Army Locust!
content:
Chapter 609 - 609 Level-Nine Forbidden Area; Desert Army Locust!

Chapter 609 - 609 Level-Nine Forbidden Area; Desert Army Locust!

609 Level-Nine Forbidden Area; Desert Army Locust!

Li Country’s live broadcast room was in a hubbub.

Carl: [No!]

Myrens: [Eugene Giles, why did you shoot?]

Josh: [Why?!]

Bevan: [Ga City has become a desert!]

Darrell: [Didn’t Eugene Giles shoot? Why is Lin Fan and the others fine, but Eugene Giles’ head was blown up? Who can tell me what happened?]

Scale: [Our country is finished!]

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing said, “The scenery in the Otherworld is really good.”

BroadSky: [I think I heard gunshots too.]

Omen: [They’re gunshots! Eugene Giles from Li Country just shot at God Lin! However, God Lin is fine, but Eugene Giles had his head blown off.]

Zhao Hai: [F*ck! I just saw the live broadcast of Li Country. Eugene Giles died so tragically, but it feels good!]

1314: [Hahaha! He even dared to shoot God Lin. He probably didn’t even know how he died, right?]

…

Naturally, Lin Fan had no idea about the reactions of Hua Nation and Li Country.

Killing Eugene Giles was just a small matter.

He did not take it to heart at all.

Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, Sam, and the rest had just left when an emotionless voice suddenly sounded in their ears.

[Entering level-nine forbidden area, countdown!]

[10!]

[9!]

[8!]

…

The same voice rang in the ears of everyone in the Otherworld.

Most of the people had a look of fear on their faces.

This was because they still clearly remembered how terrifying the level-eight forbidden area was.

In fact, many had almost died inside.

What would the level-nine forbidden area be like this time?

No matter what they thought, it was obviously useless.

[2!]

[1!]

As the emotionless voice fell, Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, Sam, and all the heroes from the other countries disappeared from where they were.

In the next moment, everyone appeared in the vast desert.

A dazzling sun hung in the air like a fireball.

Hot sweat dripped down their faces.

“It’s so hot,” Sam said. “Is the level-nine forbidden area in the desert? There are also cacti there, a huge number of them!

“But what danger can there be in the desert?”

As soon as Sam finished speaking, the distance suddenly became foggy.

Then, it covered the sky and the sun.

“Sandstorm!” Sam’s pupils constricted as he shouted. “Master, there’s a sandstorm ahead!”

After saying that, he hurriedly looked around as if he was looking for a place to hide.

However, he soon realized that he was surrounded by yellow sand and there was no way to seek shelter.

“Master, what should we do?” Sam asked anxiously. “It’s such a huge sandstorm. We might be buried alive!”

“This isn’t a sandstorm,” Lin Fan said.

“Not a sandstorm?” Sam was stunned.

Then, he looked forward again.

Soon, he frowned and said, “It’s a sandstorm… Ah! No!

“Bugs, so many bugs!”

Black carapace with sharp antennae…

That was right!

There was an uncountable number of bugs.

It was not a sandstorm!

“Why are there so many bugs? They’re flying toward us!” Sam shouted.

At this moment, the dense swarm of bugs was getting closer and closer to Lin Fan and the others.

When they passed by the cacti, the number of cacti decreased at a speed visible to the naked eye.

Soon, there was nothing left.

These bugs actually possessed terrifying destructive power!

“Master, what should we do?” Sam shouted in horror.

“It’s fine,” Lin Fan said casually.

The insects flew extremely fast.

100 meters.

90 meters.

…

In the blink of an eye, the dense swarm of bugs had reached ten meters away.

Seeing this…

Sam’s forehead was covered in sweat.

Firstly, it was from the heat.

Secondly, it was from fear.

There were simply too many bugs. Just their numbers alone were enough to make one’s scalp tingle.

Moreover, they had terrifying destructive power.

At this moment, the densely packed insects suddenly lit up with raging flames.

However, these flames did not cause much damage to the bugs. They continued flapping their wings and turned into fireballs that filled the sky as they continued to fly toward Lin Fan and the others.

Lin Fan was slightly surprised, “Oh? Resistant to fire?”

Then, he said thoughtfully, “Could it be because they’ve been living in the desert for a long time?

“If you’re not afraid of fire, what about ice?”

Lin Fan willed the ice particles to condense.

A thick layer of ice immediately formed on the bugs that were originally burning with flames.

Then, the bugs that filled the sky turned into huge ice cubes and fell to the desert with a dull sound.

This scene stunned Sam. His mouth was half open, and he could not speak for a long time.

After a while, an emotionless voice rang out.

[First to kill a level-six Desert Army Locust. You’ve obtained a level-six treasure chest.]

[First to kill a level-six Desert Army Locust. The number of endangered creatures in Hua Nation has increased by 50%.]

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing was stunned. “It’s hailing in the desert.”

Whose Fault I’m Lonely: [F*ck! When those bugs appeared, they almost scared me to death! Fortunately, they were frozen in the blink of an eye!]

Without a Trace: [Was this also done by God Lin?]

Warm Wine: [Of course, this was done by God Lin! Other than him, who else could make a miracle like this, having hail appear in the desert? God Lin is so awesome!]

Boiling Water: [Endangered creatures have increased by 50%. If God Lin gets this reward a few more times, won’t every family be able to raise a panda in the future?!]

Gulugulu: [I want to raise elk!]

Flowing Water on the Mountain: [I want to raise a tiger!]

…

Gradually, the comments in Hua Nation’s live broadcast room turned into people saying what kind of animals they would like to raise.

It was as though they were in an animal-related live broadcast.

…

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

He immediately focused his attention on the level-six treasure chest in front of him and slowly opened it.

[You’ve obtained 400 Constitution points. Do you want to use them?]

Then, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—4,000 Constitution points.]

The surging energy flowed within Lin Fan’s body.

His strength increased once again.

Lin Fan looked at Sam and said, “Use these 400 Constitution points.”

Without waiting for Sam to respond, Lin Fan waved his hand and the ball of light entered Sam’s body.

Sam felt the power in his body skyrocketing and came back to his senses. He said excitedly, “Thank you, Master!”

Lin Fan waved his hand and continued walking forward.
